description: US election money, cleaned and rolled up (FEC + state and city filings; 2026 cycle plus 2022 and 2018). table: races (per House/Senate race: candidate receipts, outside spending for/against), candidates, donor_geo (donations by city/state/division/region), race_geo, flows (donor state -> race state), spending (campaign spending by category and vendor city), vendors, state_local (state and city contribution totals with in/out-of-state split), state_local_geo. Free keys get every race's totals and national/regional/state donor geography; deeper tables come with PoliSpend from $29 at https://finzdata.com/political-spending-data .
name: get_political_spending
title: Get political spending (PoliSpend)
